points.text: Poland began two days of national mourning after a Krakow mass shooting killed several people and wounded others; authorities launched a terrorism probe, but the motive remains unclear.
A migrant boat sank off Senegal’s northwestern coast, killing at least 21 people; authorities said the death toll is provisional.
A magnitude 5.7 earthquake in central Japan injured more than 20 people in Shizuoka and Aichi; no tsunami warning was issued.
Falling debris from an attempted attack damaged a Saudi Aramco administrative building in Riyadh; no injuries or fatalities were reported.
Two trains collided in Egypt’s Giza province, killing four people and injuring 88, with several carriages derailing.
